purpose: Form PAS-2 is used to file the information memorandum with the Registrar for a second or subsequent offer of securities under a shelf prospectus.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Within one month prior to the issue of a second or subsequent offer of securities under the shelf prospectus.
steps: Prepare the information memorandum in Form PAS-2.
Pay the required fee as provided in the Companies (Registration Offices and Fees) Rules, 2014.
File Form PAS-2 with the Registrar within the specified time.
checklist: Information memorandum prepared in Form PAS-2
Fee amount as per the Companies (Registration Offices and Fees) Rules, 2014
Details of the shelf prospectus and the second or subsequent offer of securities
watch: File the form within one month prior to the issue of the second or subsequent offer.
